title: Split Dog Cyborg
description: A surreal anthropomorphic dog character stands centered, vertically split down the middle. The left side is a pale purple melting form with pink glowing eye and flower accents, wearing a denim vest covered in 1983 patches. The right side is an orange-brown melting robotic form with glowing orange eye, green dripping ear, and a vest covered in 2021 barcode and QR code patches. It holds a glowing blue crystalline object in its left hand and a metal shield in its right.
prompt: A surreal vertically bisected anthropomorphic dog standing upright, left half is a melting pale purple creature with pink glowing eye and cherry blossom details, right half is an orange dripping cyborg with glowing orange eye and green ear, wearing a denim vest covered in retro 1983 patches on left and modern 2021 QR code and barcode patches on right, holding a glowing blue crystal in left paw and metal shield in right, dramatic neon lighting with pink and cyan beams, paint drips and wires on the ground, dark purple background
